# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 01 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale — New Price Record

- **First HDB resale flat to cross S$1.8M sold at SkyParc @ Dawson** - A 5-room flat at SkyParc @ Dawson in Queenstown transacted at S$1.818 million, setting a new record on both absolute price and psf basis for the unit type. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/first-s1-8m-hdb-resale-flat-in-singapore-recorded-in-queenstown/)

- **The S$1.818M sale sits S$588,000 above Queenstown's 12-month median** - The transaction is S$588,000 above the area's 12-month median of S$1.23M and S$298,000 above the block's previous high, according to price-context data. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/skyparc-dawson-five-room-1818-record/)

## Condo Resale & New Launches

- **Condo resale volumes rose 10.8% month-on-month in September 2026** - An estimated 1,093 units changed hands in September, with price gains largely driven by stronger performance in the Core Central Region. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-recovers-as-prices-continue-to-rise-in-september-2026/)

- **Hong Leong-TID joint venture wins Orchard Boulevard GLS site at S$1,755 psf ppr** - The joint venture submitted the highest of five bids at S$181.86 million for the site, with analysts expecting new homes to launch from S$3,500 psf. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hong-leong-tid-jv-top-bids-orchard-boulevard-gls-site-at-s1755-psf-ppr/)

## Land Supply — Reserve List Sites

- **Two GLS Reserve List sites at Chuan Grove and former Raffles Town Club could add 1,180 homes** - URA has released the two residential sites under the 2H2026 GLS Reserve List, with Chuan Grove estimated to yield around 930 units and the former Raffles Town Club site along Plymouth Avenue/Dunearn Road accounting for the remainder. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/gls-reserve-list-site-chuan-grove-former-raffles-town-club-1180-homes/)
